# WOFF Font File

## Summary
The font specialization for WOFF (Web Open Font Format).
An instance is an uploaded realm file with card semantics: the binary lives at
the file URL while the card carries extracted metadata and renders with
format-aware templates.

## Shape
Extends `FontDef`. Adds no fields of its own. WOFF wraps an sfnt for the web with per-table zlib
compression, which the extract pass inflates on demand — so unlike WOFF2, a WOFF
indexes with full name, OS/2 and glyph metadata available. That difference in
indexing depth is the reason the two web font formats are separate defs.

Accepts: `.woff, font/woff`

## Example
```ts
import { WoffDef } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/woff-font-def';

@field attachment = linksTo(WoffDef);
```
Instances are created by upload (`createFileDef` wires the type from the
MIME type). Live examples need uploaded fixtures — `Spec` has no field that
accepts a file today (`linkedExamples` is `linksToMany(CardDef)`, and
`FileDef` is a sibling of `CardDef`), so the example check stays open for
every file def until `fileExamples` lands.
